22.description: Council approved the Saskatoon Accessible Advisory Committee appointing its Chair and Vice-Chair for 2026.

chips.text: Darren Gilchrist nominated for Chair; Steven Schneider for Vice-Chair

17.description: Council received an overview of the Multi-Year Accessibility Plan, which outlines strategies to improve accessibility across the city.

chips.text: Staff will connect to align on future focus for the accessibility plan by 2026.

7.description: The committee discussed its 2026 work plan and budget, including how to allocate $3,000 for conferences and education.

chips.text: Subcommittee appointments were deferred until the 2026 work plan topics are finalized.
The committee reviews deafblind services and educates Saskatoon on accessibility matters.
